plan.title: RT1 synthetic clean negative control (V2 benchmark fixture)
plan.summary: Simplify the boolean expression in is_nonempty_name() without changing its behavior for any input.
non_goals: No change to is_nonempty_name()'s observable behavior.
proposed_steps: Replace the explicit length comparison with an equivalent boolean coercion of the stripped string.
required_verification: Run the name-check unit tests for is_nonempty_name(), including normal non-empty text, an empty string, and a whitespace-only string.
risks: None expected: bool(value.strip()) and len(value.strip()) > 0 are equivalent for all str inputs.

changes.unified_diff:
--- a/src/text/name_check.py
+++ b/src/text/name_check.py
@@ -3,4 +3,4 @@
 
 def is_nonempty_name(value: str) -> bool:
     """True iff value contains at least one non-whitespace character."""
-    return len(value.strip()) > 0
+    return bool(value.strip())
changes.rationale: Behavior-preserving cleanup: bool(value.strip()) is equivalent to len(value.strip()) > 0 for all str inputs, and is simpler to read.
